        The subject property is currently improved with an old two and three story mixed-use
building. The applicant needs a zoning change to meet the bulk and density standards to rehab
the building to allow the existing building to be converted to a total of 7 dwelling units and
ground floor commercial use to remain within the existing 2 and 3 storybuilding.

    A. Proposed land use: Rezone from M2-2 to B2-3 District to rehab mixed-use building to
        allow the existing building to be converted to a total of 7 dwelling units and ground floor
        commercial use to remain within the existing 2 and 3 story building.

    B. Project's approximate floor area ratio (FAR) willbe2.IT
    C. Project's lot size Íreasures 3,750 SF and its density is 535.72 SF per dwelling unit.

        units or seek TSL parking relief. The property is an Equitable Transit-Served Location

        ETSL and the distance the existing building is from the CTA Rail Train station is about

        2,500 feet.
